artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module, standard library only. snippet(text, limit=120) strips tags (entity-encoded too), removes https?://\S+, \S+@\S+ and runs of 20 or more characters from [A-Za-z0-9+/_=-], collapses whitespace and cuts to limit. prune(rows, stamp, now, cap) keeps rows whose stamp is within 7 days of now (unreadable stamps dropped), oldest first, newest cap only. No AWS call; not deployed.

Import of folder_records as fr; MENTIONS_KEY = 'mentions', MENTIONS_CAP = 50; new _keep_mention(ctx, p, m) writes {id, team, channel, from, snippet, mentioned_at, seen_at} once per id, pruned on write; on_channel_mention calls _keep_mention after ctx.once, so the record is written only where the text is sent (paused path returns before). The text, the once key and the return value are unchanged. No AWS call; not deployed.

Import of folder_records as fr; MAIL_LOG_KEY = 'mail_log', MAIL_LOG_CAP = 10; new _log_mail(ctx, pending, who, addr, subject) appends {seq, tag, considered_at, from, domain, firm, subject} and prunes on write; on_mail_messages calls it on the line directly after ctx.state['pending'] = pending. pending, draft_seq, the text and the counts are unchanged. No AWS call; not deployed.
